source_outcomes.claim: First native-label LV citizenship query with two or more sitelinks.
Combined query with GROUP_CONCAT occupations returned HTTP 502.
Unbanded query with English description returned truncated JSON.
wbgetentities HTTP 429 after 15 cached batches (750 IDs); remaining 3,474 IDs used SPARQL VALUES chunks.

verification: Exact first token of a native label must equal a calendar spelling with fewer than five local bearers in the pre-round snapshot. Role comes from the English description, else from the first P106 occupation label that maps to an existing widget role; 1,003 candidate rows without a mappable role are excluded.
claim_limits: A single Wikipedia sitelink indicates a published encyclopedia biography, usually in the national language; it is a weaker prominence signal than the earlier two-sitelink threshold, and such people rank below better-known local bearers.
Birthplace P19/P17 remains geographic evidence, distinct from citizenship P27.
Native labels support exact spelling, not a legal given name. No transliteration or related form is added.
Occupation-based roles use Wikidata P106 labels only; no role is inferred from names or descriptions in other languages.
failed_leads: Three failures above are recorded and not retried. Earlier birthday and label collection failures remain closed.
